plan.question: Which caller SQL operation accounts for sample-loading time and long waits, and does this clarify16/8MiB tradeoff?
plan.order: 16/8 on even pairs;8/16 on odd; each process fresh; all warmups/controls separate
plan.workload: unchanged shop70:50 shared reads,20 private writers,40 sample orders/loader; one extra shared-reader Fork on both settings
plan.duration_precision: integer microseconds per caller SQL operation
plan.retention: All durations by phase; contextual global begin/order/product IDs and errors for calls>=50ms. No file writes or global lock per SQL call. One record emission per loader. Persist after suite timing.
plan.analysis: Per-call p50/p95/max, per-loader phase totals, >=100/500ms events and timeline alignment. Parallel elapsed is not CPU. No lock-holder or UNDO/shim attribution from caller timings alone.
plan.exit: Exactly five instrumented pairs plus fixed warmup/sanity controls, or named missing input. Retain all tails; no automatic extra sampling or product default change.
